versions.name: Ingersoll Scout Reservation

features.note: Indoor and outdoor seating with a kitchen and adjacent commissary.
A 50-foot tower with three walls of varying difficulty and a giant's ladder.
A 350-foot zip line from the climbing tower.
The Lake Roberts lakefront, with a sand beach, a large dock, and boat storage.
The Fish Shack, with teaching space and fish-cleaning facilities.
Scoutcraft crafts including woodcarving and basketry.
Ecology and Conservation, offering nature and science merit badges.
Solo Scouts can be matched with another troop attending camp.

versions.summary: Set on roughly 650 acres near London Mills, W. D. Boyce Council's primary Scouts BSA resident camp features a 50-foot climbing tower and zipline, Lake Roberts waterfront, shooting sports, Eco-Con, Scoutcraft, and cooking.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
